id.description: Stable key for saved progress. Never change it once the level has been released.

map.description:
Top-down tile map, one string per row (row 0 is the north/top wall).
  #  wall            .  floor           X  exit (on the outer wall; the street goes outside it)
  P  player start    L  emergency stop: button on the adjacent north, east or west wall
  H  hopper; a belt starts next to it and runs (> < ^ v) into a grinder G
  S  sorter: splits the belt, males to a grinder G, females on to an egg farm F
  B  large crate (blocks sight)          b  small crate (low, see-through)
  T  parked loader   R  robot arm        c  traffic cone
The production line must be at least 12 walking steps from every exit.

guards.description: One patrol route per guard: walkable [col, row] tiles visited in order, looping.

parSeconds.description: Finishing faster than this earns a time bonus.

totalChicks.description: Chicks the hoppers drop over the whole level.

chicksToSave.description: Chicks that must reach an exit to win.

maxLost.description: The level is lost once this many chicks are ground up or caged.

beltSpeed.description: Belt speed in tiles per second.

spawnInterval.description: Seconds between drops at the start and at the end of the level.

guardSight.description: How well guards see on this level. Defaults to the values in tuning.ts.

range.description: How far guards see, in tiles.

fieldOfView.description: Width of the vision cone, in degrees.
